title: Future done-callbacks run after rejection — residual channel needs scoping decision
description: python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py:709-710, 721-722 + python/src/lichen/_sync_callbacks.py:26-27: a hook may attach add_done_callback to a Future before returning it; Future.cancel() synchronously schedules those callbacks to run on the NEXT loop iteration, so attacker code can still execute after the rejection raises. reject_awaitable_result cannot prevent this for Futures. Neither the tests nor the bead threat model covers or documents this residual channel — file a scoping decision (document as accepted residual in the helper docstring, or restrict hook results to Task/coroutine/custom). Needs a human/spec decision, not a blind fix.
